1: // Minimal Orbital Defender game
2: // Assumes a <canvas id="game"></canvas> present in the page
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
8:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
9: 
10:   const planet = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height / 2, r: 40 };
11:   const ship = { angle: 0, r: 80, size: 10, cooldown: 0 };
12:   const projectiles = [];
13:   const asteroids = [];
14:   let gameOver = false;
15:   let score = 0;
16: 
17:   // Input handling
18:   const keys = {};
19:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.code] = true; });
20:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.code] = false; });
21: 
22:   function spawnAsteroid() {
23:     // random angle around planet
24:     const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
25:     const dist = Math.max(canvas.width, canvas.height);
26:     const x = planet.x + Math.cos(angle) * dist;
27:     const y = planet.y + Math.sin(angle) * dist;
28:     const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 1.5;
29:     const vx = (planet.x - x) / dist * speed;
30:     const vy = (planet.y - y) / dist * speed;
31:     const r = 8 + Math.random() * 12;
32:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, r });
33:   }
34: 
35:   function update(dt) {
36:     if (gameOver) return;
37:     // Ship rotation
38:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.angle -= 2 * Math.PI / 180 * dt;
39:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.angle += 2 * Math.PI / 180 * dt;
40:     // Fire
41:     if (keys['Space'] && ship.cooldown <= 0) {
42:       const px = planet.x + Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.r;
43:       const py = planet.y + Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.r;
44:       const speed = 4;
45:       projectiles.push({ x: px, y: py, vx: Math.cos(ship.angle) * speed, vy: Math.sin(ship.angle) * speed, life: 60 });
46:       ship.cooldown = 20; // frames
47:     }
48:     ship.cooldown = Math.max(0, ship.cooldown - 1);
49: 
50:     // Update projectiles
51:     for (let i = projectiles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
52:       const p = projectiles[i];
53:       p.x += p.vx;
54:       p.y += p.vy;
55:       p.life--;
56:       if (p.life <= 0) projectiles.splice(i, 1);
57:     }
58: 
59:     // Update asteroids
60:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
61:       const a = asteroids[i];
62:       a.x += a.vx;
63:       a.y += a.vy;
64:       // collision with planet
65:       const dx = a.x - planet.x;
66:       const dy = a.y - planet.y;
67:       if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) < a.r + planet.r) {
68:         gameOver = true;
69:         break;
70:       }
71:       // collision with projectiles
72:       for (let j = projectiles.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
73:         const p = projectiles[j];
74:         if (Math.hypot(a.x - p.x, a.y - p.y) < a.r + 2) {
75:           score += 10;
76:           asteroids.splice(i, 1);
77:           projectiles.splice(j, 1);
78:           break;
79:         }
80:       }
81:     }
82: 
83:     // Periodically spawn asteroids
84:     if (Math.random() < 0.02) spawnAsteroid();
85:   }
86: 
87:   function draw() {
88:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
89:     // planet
90:     ctx.fillStyle = '#663300';
91:     ctx.beginPath();
92:     ctx.arc(planet.x, planet.y, planet.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
93:     ctx.fill();
94:     // ship
95:     const sx = planet.x + Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.r;
96:     const sy = planet.y + Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.r;
97:     ctx.fillStyle = '#00ff00';
98:     ctx.beginPath();
99:     ctx.arc(sx, sy, ship.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
100:     ctx.fill();
101:     // projectiles
102:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ffff00';
103:     for (const p of projectiles) {
104:       ctx.fillRect(p.x - 2, p.y - 2, 4, 4);
105:     }
106:     // asteroids
107:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888888';
108:     for (const a of asteroids) {
109:       ctx.beginPath();
110:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
111:       ctx.fill();
112:     }
113:     // UI
114:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
115:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
116:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
117:     if (gameOver) {
118:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
119:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
120:     }
121:     ctx.textAlign = 'start';
122:   }
123: 
124:   let last = performance.now();
125:   function loop(now) {
126:     const dt = (now - last) / 16.666; // approximate 60fps frames
127:     last = now;
128:     update(dt);
129:     draw();
130:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
131:   }
132:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
